response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior developer with strong full-stack and some high-performance systems background (low-latency DLang microservices handling millions of requests per second), but falls well short of the core requirement of 8 years of C++ experience — C++ appears only in a ~7-month role and a thesis project. His career centers on web/product engineering in TypeScript/Node.js rather than cloud compute platforms, and there is no evidence of formal technical leadership mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers at the scale this role demands.
strengths: Experience with low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Broad engineering versatility with strong testing culture (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and mentoring via workshops and courses
Long-running ownership of an open-source platform (GISCollective) deployed on Kubernetes, showing ability to drive ambiguous projects to completion
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience — only brief professional C++ exposure
No dedicated technical leadership role leading cloud/infrastructure teams or platform strategy
Career trajectory is web/product-focused (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than large-scale compute, storage, or hardware architecture

key_factors.factor: Limited cloud platform leadership track record
